author: Wes
text:
I'd like to dig a little deeper on the diagrams IF posted a few days back.

(1) Price engulfs the LFL, and retraces all the way back to pick up the
remaining orders (most extreme set of orders - MPL) in the UFL. (2)
After that price goes South again until it meets its next target - the
next LFL (3) because price has hit a target we're allowed to draw in the
 new UFL (yellow box)

At current price we have no PA in this scale until we engulf the blue LFL at (4) or the extreme of the newly formed UFL(2)

While drawing this a thought came to mind. In my diagram price picks up
the remaining orders immediately (as opposed to IFs diagram) Isn't this
then a starting compression?

author: Ifmyante
text: Essentially, yes

author: dengaima
text:
Ifmyante I got a stupid question, which has been bothering me, but I hope you can clarify it.

You mentioned lately that FL can be only drawn once price has hit it's target.

How do we trade FTB, if the target was been hit.

As the engulf that has hit it's target is not tradeable.

Also, if price has hits it target, there is possibility that price will break the FL on FTB, right?

Dengaima

author: einrikr
text:
May I have a crack on this?

I hope I understand you correctly, but here goes:

The FL can only be drawn if price hit it's target means that if price
doesn't retrace back far enough, it's not hitting the FL below and
therefore it's no new FL but price just goes beyond it.

There are several targets for price in several stages of it moving.

The target for a new FL, is the FL below (or above) it and that has to be hit.

I hope that clarifies it, and that I'm explaining it correctly!

author: Astrokillah
text:
Hi Einrikr, hope you don't mind me chipping in. I think you didn't actually address his question , he was asking this:

Let's say a kink is created after price engulf an existing FL, but we
cannot immediately consider the kink as an FL (because price hasn't
reached the next FL in the direction of an engulf), that means we have
no basis to trade FTB (back to the kink) then, because there's no FL to
 begin with?

And then he followed it up with, let's say price eventually hit the next
 FL (target) and it reverse back towards the kink (now an FL), we still
cannot trade FTB then, because there is no PA in either direction, we
need to wait for either one of UFL or LFL to be engulfed.

So isn't the only scenario to trade FTB is for price to first reach a
target FL (allow us to consider the kink as new FL), and then it needs
to engulf the target FL before coming back to the kink, then we can
trade FTB?

Cheers

Ak
